changes: Listing Consult autosave fix: previously each step (prep/walkthrough/close/lockin) only persisted to the server when the agent clicked that step's explicit Next button. Exiting mid-step (as Alex reported for the Present & Close page) silently discarded everything typed on that step because handleResumeConsult only rebuilds state from server-saved data.section values. Added a debounced (~1.1s) autosave useEffect, gated on resumePhase==="ready" and non-empty client/address, that mirrors each step's exact existing saveSection payload so mid-step exits no longer lose data. Client-only change, same merge-patch endpoint (/api/listing-consult/:id/data) as before.

Payment methods audit: PAYMENT_METHODS enum and PaymentRecordModal's METHOD_LABELS swapped "cash_app" for "money_order" so the accepted list exactly matches Alex's confirmed list (Cash, Wire, Check, Money Order, Venmo, Zelle, Apple Pay). Added evidence-label handling for money_order ("a photo of the money order"). Added a single-source-of-truth ACCEPTED_PAYMENT_METHODS_LABEL constant in server/payments.ts, referenced from Repair Consult's IN_HOUSE_TERMS + Section 3 of the Repair & Renovation Agreement, and from Inspections+' INSPECTION_TERMS (with added seamless buyer earnest-deposit sequencing language).

endpoints.__note: sourceId is a nonexistent throwaway id. Expecting 404 'Source record not found' proves money_order passed the PAYMENT_METHODS/amount/signature checks and reached the source lookup (no DB write occurs before that lookup).

Same body as above except the retired cash_app method. Expecting 400 (rejected at the PAYMENT_METHODS.includes check, before ever reaching source lookup) proves cash_app is no longer accepted in production.

__bundleNotes: money_order/Money Order and cash_app/Cash App are plain string literals (object keys + comparisons), never minified away, so their presence/absence in the deployed bundle is a reliable signal.
